turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
An item cannot be added to an order that has already been validated. The current order would need to be cancelled and refunded before you place a new order with the additional item.

Please send your email address and order number so I can arrange the appropriate next step.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
If you mean adding or changing a product, no. A product cannot be added to an order once it has been validated, and this is not possible after shipment either. You would need to place a separate order.

If you mean changing the delivery address or date, this may depend on the carrier and the order status. Please tell me which change you need and send your order number so I can check the available option.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
There is no guaranteed fixed timeframe for a refund after a standard cancellation. If the cancellation is confirmed before preparation, the refund process starts once the cancellation is completed.

If the order has already shipped, you must refuse the parcel on delivery. It will return to the warehouse, and the refund process will then begin. Once the refund has been issued, your bank may take around 72 hours to show the funds.

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail: No. Separate orders cannot be merged after validation. The available option is to keep them as separate orders, with each one processed and shipped independently. They may therefore arrive in separate shipments.

turns.q: Will I get an email confirmation once the change is made?
turns.replyTail:
The order confirmation email confirms that the order was recorded and the initial payment was charged. For a later payment-method change, I can’t promise that a separate confirmation email will be sent.

Please send your order number and the email address used for the purchase so the request can be checked.
